title: Temple of the Nine Rings
description: An autumn Japanese Buddhist temple ensemble: a sweeping curved irimoya worship hall, a golden seated Buddha behind paper screens, a three-storey pagoda crowned by a nine-ring sorin, and an open pavilion with a suspended bronze bell and timber striker. A small lotus pool and autumn maple frame the stair approaches without hiding the architecture.
